profile.headline: Systems Engineer II
profile.summary: Software and systems engineer with 8+ years of experience across automotive and aerospace. Skilled in requirements and systems engineering, Java, C/C++, Python, AWS, Linux, DevOps, and hardware/software integration, with experience in system architecture, validation, mission-data processing, and automated testing.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
• Automated camera NVM validation using DXL and Python scripts to export IBM DOORS module data to Excel and compare device NVM contents against the exported dataset 
• Developed system and interface requirements from customer requirements and maintained end-to-end traceability through detailed requirements, architecture, and system verification 
• Developed system architectures and maintained requirements traceability in CATIA No Magic 
• Performed and supported System FMEA activities to identify and mitigate system-level failure 
• Ensured system development and validation activities complied with ISO 26262 ASIL and Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Generated software development requirements based on customer standard specifications 
• Utilized Cameo to generate SysML models based on MIL-STD requirements/commands 
• Created Cameo Model plugin feature to upload and validate file composition integrity 
• Developed in an Agile DevOps environment to meet deadlines and present customers with a completed product 
• Deployed code changes to simulated rocket hardware using launch data to validate code integrity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Assisted in code development, debugging, optimization and testing 
• Deployed code changes to simulated rocket hardware 
• Generated and debugged core dump files to confirm code integrity 
• Created build documentation that included timelines, dependencies, and sequence of events 
• Verified software objectives through inspections, reviews, walkthroughs, and audits 
• Utilized various Agile technologies such as Jira and Confluence 
• Researched and integrated existing technology applicable to ongoing programs 
• Utilized Big Data technologies to process mission data 
• Leveraged Apache Spark to decrease mission-data processing time 
• Employed Kafka and Spark Streaming infrastructure for real-time streaming 
• Optimized parallel signal processing capabilities for a software-defined radio using Spark 
• Utilized Amazon Web Services such as Lambda and EC2 to benchmark batch processing algorithms to determine cost efficiency of AWS for cloud server hosting 
• Deployed SonarQube to help perform code quality checks and debugging via Jenkins

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Assisted in resolving critical Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) by helping determine the issue, researching possible resolutions and presenting resolutions to closeout NCR 
• Provided instructions or clarification for Wire Harness Assemblies, click bond bonding, Access Kits Install/Removal and LH2/LOX Umbilical panels install 
• Utilized Creo Viewer to create an accurate 3D mapping of all exterior parts of the vehicle 
• Created, updated, incorporated Procedure Change Instructions for various WADs (Work as Documented) 
• Coordinated between Production, Quality Assurance and NASA Defense Contract Management Agency to closeout WO or NCRs 
• Verified and provided wire harness routing in Engine Section for Core Stage Two

positions.title: Information Technology Technical Support
positions.description:
• Responded to calls, emails, and chats to assist in troubleshooting problems 
• Replicated reported technical problems and identified solutions 
• Installed updates of software and development requirements on time 
• Tested Network Attachment Storages (NAS) systems, network and hardware to ensure proper function 
• Performed debugging in Linux
positions.insights: IT Support, Customer Interaction and +7 skills
